diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~31% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. A few outliers stand out (787 points, ~2% of the sample). The series crosses zero, so percentage errors are unstable and mean-based combinations are safer than ratio-based ones. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.516), which favours a selective combination.
